create.name: Dr. Miles Neale
create.bio:
Dr. Miles Neale is a teacher of Tibetan Buddhism and a psychologist who has spent his career bringing the classical lam rim, the stage-by-stage path to awakening, into conversation with Western psychology. He trained for more than two decades under the Tibetan teacher Geshe Tenzin Zopa, practised as a psychotherapist in New York City for many years and has taught contemplative psychology at several medical schools. In 2018 he launched his book Gradual Awakening at a nunnery in Kathmandu during a pilgrimage, and the study group that grew out of that trip became the Gradual Path, the learning community he now leads with Dr. Emily Wolf.

His courses move in order through the traditional stages, from refuge and renunciation to compassion and finally tantric visualisation, and draw on Carl Jung and Joseph Campbell to help students meet their own shadow rather than bypass it. Most teaching is online, either as on-demand series or live cohorts, alongside a long certificate programme. He also guides group pilgrimages each year, among them an annual journey to the Tsum Valley in Nepal with his teacher and walking pilgrimages in Spain and Japan, and he is now based in Bali. His latest book is Return with Elixir.

courses.title: Jung and Tibetan Buddhism: Transformation Without Bypassing
courses.description: A twelve-week live online course on Tuesday evenings, moving through the Tibetan path from foundations to compassion to tantra, with Jung's depth psychology used as a guard against spiritual bypassing. Sessions are recorded.

courses.title: The Contemplative Studies Immersion & Certificate
courses.description: His full on-demand curriculum: eight courses of lectures, readings and guided meditation workshops, about 160 hours in all, that work step by step through the lam rim with a certificate at the end.

courses.title: Foundations of the Buddhist Path
courses.description: A six-class on-demand introduction to the opening stages of the lam rim, co-hosted with Tibet House US, covering refuge, renunciation and the first steps of compassion.

courses.title: Enter the Mandala: Tsum Valley Pilgrimage 2027
courses.description: His annual pilgrimage to the Tsum Valley in Nepal with Geshe Tenzin Zopa, with study, meditation and visits to holy sites; pilgrims can trek or fly in. Currently waitlist only.

free_resources.title: Wisdom Keeper Podcast
free_resources.description: His free podcast, linked from the Gradual Path site, with talks and conversations on Tibetan Buddhism, psychology and pilgrimage.

sprint.held: Psychedelics: his own therapy page (milesneale.com/therapy) lists 'post-psychedelic and post-pilgrimage integration' among his services, and his latest book Return with Elixir is pitched to 'psychonauts' and 'psychedelic wayfarers' and covers integration after psychedelic ceremony. Held for the owner under the psychedelics rule. Note also that much of his work is psychotherapy.
